workflows.objective: Discover original scenarios across storytelling lanes and obtain an actual user choice.
steps: Generate varied setup-development-payoff pitches, not compulsory tearjerkers.
Choose lane, mechanism, visual style and optional subtle local texture separately.
Apply hard gates before ranking.
Explain provisional score and dominant production risk.
Use cross-lane shortlist; record only actual feedback.
Create selected-story workspace; no paid calls.
workflows.exit: User selection, not an automatic winner.

workflows.objective: Iterate real characters, real scenes and the complete visual design before motion.
inputs: live image forms/quotes and bounded per-step consent
steps: Write provisional story/style and opening-hook alternatives; do not confuse a sketch with production art.
Generate the first actual cast reference from characterPlan; show it and stop for user face/wardrobe/style/scale feedback.
Record real output provenance and character/user reviews; advance characters-approved.
Develop each literal scene endpoint using accepted cast and continuity references; show scene candidates before dependent spending.
Design every scene transition, first-frame/first-motion hook, beat timing and motivated light/shadow state.
Consider butterflies, flowers, sakura, rain, wind/trees, autumn and illuminated/highlight accents as coherent options; set motion budget, timing, masks/depth, spill/shadows and fallback.
Review all actual scene images side by side with the user; sketches cannot satisfy keyframes-approved.
Test selected composite assets/rights in a capable editor where required; the assembler does not implement effects.
Lock final script, pacing, transitions, camera, lights/shadows, effects and sound route with actual design-user evidence; advance design-locked.
workflows.exit: Actual user-approved cast and scenes plus a hash-bound locked design; no media quality inferred from prose.

workflows.objective: Animate the locked design without duplicate jobs or unapproved spending.
steps: Recheck exact model limits, duration choices, approved effect route and repair budget.
Validate scene/user/design reviews, production provenance and exact start/end references.
Set nextGenerationKind motion, validate spend and exact motion payload before submission.
Submit one approved clip; record historyId and charged attempt immediately, then resume that job.
Review actual opening hook, identities/contact, nature/effect motion, lighting/shadows and achieved reveal/response/hold timing.
Repair only the diagnosed failed part within applicable approval; do not rerender good picture merely to decorate it.
workflows.exit: Accepted local shots, hashes and job ledger; no automatic publishability or full-playback claim from sampled frames.

workflows.objective: Build a genre-appropriate, replaceable, cleared soundtrack and final cut.
steps: Align ambience/foley to actual motion.
Compare nostalgic, modern and original alternatives when songs are appropriate.
For singing or tempo adaptation, record complete phrase, voice permissions, pitch/diction quality and actual target duration.
Test music/no-music on the same locked picture.
Compare native route only with honest whole-system labeling.
Inspect silence, transitions, sync, accidental voices and phone playback.
Assemble export and record current asset hashes.
Run every final review and obtain user approval.
workflows.exit: Hash-bound final approval, not automatic publication.

workflows.objective: Measure comprehension, emotion and useful audience behavior without biochemical claims.
inputs: declared primary outcome and stopping rule
steps: Capture current Insights definitions and trial settings.
Obtain explicit publication approval.
Record fixed-window counts, denominators, audience mix and costs.
Distinguish cold-viewer randomization from organic distribution.
Update project-only rules with evidence and limitations.
workflows.exit: Versioned experiment result with uncertainties; no guaranteed formula or invented dopamine measurement.

workflows.objective: Understand an authorized reference's entire timeline and develop an original adaptation from real feedback.
steps: Prepare full-duration evidence without bypassing Instagram access controls.
Inspect all temporal samples and expand transitions; watch the complete motion and listen to all audio or explicitly mark unavailable.
Record complete contiguous timecoded screenplay, camera, blocking, light/shadow, pacing, text and sound observations; label inference.
Validate source identity and coverage; do not infer full understanding from a contact sheet.
Separate reusable mechanisms from protected expression and uncleared audio/voices.
Use actual like/change/avoid feedback to propose original alternatives and a tested-improvement hypothesis.
Select an original concept, then enter normal packet/model/quote/keyframe/motion/audio gates.
workflows.exit: Source-bound analysis plus feedback-driven original brief; not a copied screenplay or automatic quality/spend approval.

workflows.objective: Repair substantive studio defects until independent scoped reviews are green.
steps: Reconcile all asks and evidence; separate implemented capabilities from future production gates.
Review creative/story/pacing/visual, evidence/music/rights and workflow/delivery lenses independently when substantial review is authorized.
Record concrete findings and minimal repairs; distinguish blockers from taste.
Fix, add targeted regressions and obtain same-critic re-review.
Repeat for substantive unresolved findings, not endless aesthetic preferences.
Run syntax, tests and validation; record exact scope and residual untested facts.
Commit and push only under actual authorization; verify remote SHA and clean tracked worktree.
workflows.exit: No unresolved substantive finding within the named scope; actual validation and publication evidence, not a fictional film-quality pass.
